messages.subject: Announcement: spreadsheet 1.0 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I've created a Renjin package that can read/write Excel files and Open Document Spreadsheets (Libre/Open Office Calc).

Version 1.0 is now available through Maven Central.

See https://github.com/Alipsa/spreadsheets for more details.

Best regards,
Per
